subject: Re: FastCart production latency spike — credit request and remediation
messages:
From: Elena Vasquez <elena@fastcart.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency spike this morning — impact on checkout (Urgent)

Hi Mina,

We experienced a significant latency regression on Redwood between 08:50–09:05 PT this morning that affected our checkout flow. Customers saw timeouts and a ~30% increase in 5xx errors. Our operations team noticed a correlation with tokenization requests to the inference endpoint for our recommendations model.

This caused sustained checkout errors for ~12 minutes and a partial rollback of our cart experiments. We need two things:
- Confirmation of root cause / timeline from Redwood
- Proposal for remediation + compensation (we expect credits or trial extension to cover the production impact and to avoid churn)

We’re on a tight renewal cadence — can we get an expedited review and proposal today? I can share logs if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena
VP Ops, FastCart
Elena.V@fastcart.com

Attachments: fastcart_error_log_snippet.txt (text)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Elena Vasquez <elena@fastcart.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike this morning — impact on checkout (Urgent)

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging and for the log snippet. I’m really sorry you saw this during a critical window.

Quick update: I’ve opened an incident with our SRE team (ID: INC-20270504-FC). Jonas is looped in here to look at the trace and kernel selection for the recommendations endpoint. We’ll provide a short RCA + timeline and propose a remediation package by EOD PT.

For speed, can you confirm the approximate volume (requests/min) during the spike and whether any retries were particularly concentrated from IPs 54.12.x.x? If you prefer, we can jump on a 15-minute call.

Prelim thinking from my side: a bridging credit (tokens) to cover impacted requests + a 30-day trial extension / token top-up while we validate SLOs. I’ll circulate an exact numbers proposal after ops finishes the initial analysis.

—
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: incident_timeline.pdf (PDF, draft)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 09:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Production latency spike this morning — FastCart (need approval for credits)

Forwarding FastCart report — short briefing below.

What happened:
- Impact window: 08:50–09:05 PT on 2027-05-04
- Symptoms: elevated p95/p99 latency on recommendations model, ~30% increase in 5xxs for checkout route tied to recommendation enrichment calls
- Customer impact: checkout failures and a partial rollback of an experiments cohort (commercial risk during renewal)

Proposed customer-facing offer (pending approvals):
- 50,000 token credit applied to FastCart billing account (to cover retries and allow them to finish validation)
- 30-day trial extension for the recommendations workload with elevated support (SLA check-ins weekly for 4 weeks)
- Root-cause summary and postmortem delivered within 48 hours

Attachments: incident_timeline.pdf (draft), proposed_credit_terms.docx

Can we get greenlight from Sales/Finance to apply the credit and from Ops to confirm the RCA timeline? Elena asked for an expedited response today.

Thanks,
Mina

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production latency spike this morning — FastCart (need approval for credits)

Mina — thanks for the summary and for moving fast. I spoke with my manager and we can approve a customer relief package with these constraints:
- Token credit approved: 40,000 tokens (instead of 50k) as a one-time account credit to be applied to the next invoice.
- 30-day trial extension approved for the recommendations route, subject to a signed amendment (simple DocuSign attached).
- No changes to baseline pricing; this is a one-off remedial grant given the business impact and FastCart’s renewal momentum.

Jonas — can you confirm that Ops can deliver an RCA and a mitigation plan within 48 hours and confirm whether any kernel or quantization rollback is necessary for short-term stability? If rollback is required, include ETA and impact to live traffic.

We should also ask Legal to review the amendment — I’ll loop them if needed but prefer to move quickly.

-Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: proposed_credit_terms.docx (edited)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Elena Vasquez <elena@fastcart.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 05 May 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: FastCart — remediation package and next steps (approved)

Hi Elena — following up with the approved package and next steps. Thanks for your patience while we coordinated internally.

Summary of what Redwood will apply:
- One-time account credit: 40,000 tokens applied to FastCart account (will appear on your next invoice).
- 30-day trial extension for the recommendations endpoint with elevated support (weekly syncs for four weeks).
- RCA and mitigation plan: Ops (Jonas) will deliver a postmortem and recommended config changes within 48 hours.

Next steps for you:
- I’ve attached a simple amendment (DocuSign link below) to formalize the 30-day extension. Sign to accept; we’ll apply the credit once the amendment is sent back or approved in HubSpot.
- If you can confirm peak requests/min during the 08:50–09:05 window (or share any additional logs), Jonas can prioritize traces.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/fastcart-amendment/FC-2027-Q2-09
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/FC-2027-Q2-09

On behalf of the team, sorry again for the disruption. We value FastCart’s partnership and will do everything we can to prevent recurrence.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
